attacker_pocs.name: short-final-connection-token
attacker_pocs.why: A valid HTTP response delivered over a Unix domain socket reaches Curl_compareheader through curl_easy_perform. A short final Connection token leaves fewer bytes than the comparison length, and the changed boundary probe reads beyond the header buffer.

role_a_rationale: The patch stops the HTTP header length counter from underflowing when comma and trailing blank scanning passes the trimmed value. It also scans short remaining tokens while probing the comparison boundary before checking their length, producing a new heap overread. The change is confined to the existing token loop and preserves ordinary comma-separated matching.
